name: Men's CAP dark blue polo long sleeves, screen-printed CAP seal in white on the left breast (overlay, registered to garment-polo-male-long)
size_basis: The CAP seal asset insignia-cap-seal (Fig A6-4) reduced to a single white print: rings as outlines, lettering, stars, dots and the eagle solid, the blue field as an outline, the propeller and the scroll lettering knocked out in the shirt colour (#001b52). Diameter 2.93 in = the embroidered seal measured on Figure 5.5 (the printed polo has no figure of its own and no photograph is on disk; ESTIMATE that the print is the same size), centred on the wearer's left breast at the mirror of the embroidered seal's position about the centre line (print_seal_slot of garment-polo-male-long). CAPR 39-1 5.3.1.2 says "screen-printed in white lettering on the left breast" and no accoutrements (5.3.2.1.2).
documented: dark blue knit polo with the CAP seal screen-printed in white on the left breast, long or short sleeves (CAPR 39-1 5.3.1.2)
no accoutrements: no name, badge or embroidered seal (5.3.2.1.2)
assumed: which seal parts print solid, as outline or are knocked out (single-colour reduction of the seal asset)
the men's sheet's pocket group (id pocket) is hidden by the engine for the printed polo: it has no pocket
